Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Heptaminol Hydrochloride). A white or almost white crystalline powder. Freely soluble in water; soluble in al- cohol; practically insoluble in dichloromethane. Profile Heptaminol hydrochloride is a cardiac stimulant and vasodilator and has been given in the treatment of cardiovascular disorders. Heptaminol and heptaminol adenosine phosphate have also been used.
